requirements.general: Any of These: SPM/O-Levels: Minimum 5 credits (C's), including English and Mathematics or other relevant subjects. Actuarial Science Route (SPM/O-Levels): Minimum 5 credits (C's), including English, Mathematics, and Additional Mathematics. IB MYP: 3 subjects with Grade 6 (English and Maths). 2 subjects with Grade 5. For Actuarial Science: A Grade 5 in a subject equivalent to Additional Mathematics. Conditional Offers: Available for students with forecast results. Advance Standing: May be granted for those with appropriate pre-university qualifications. Final results are required before the program starts. Pre-requisite Subjects: Progression to an undergraduate program may require specific grades in pre-requisite subjects at SPM/O-Level/Equivalent levels, in addition to Foundation results. English Language Requirements: For Non-Native English Speakers: Evidence of English language ability is required. Minimum IELTS 5.5 (or equivalent) with no score below 5.0. English Language Courses: Offered for those who do not meet the IELTS 5.5 requirement.
